summary: Frontend-only Phase 4 validation executed: static code review + yarn build passed, but live UI verification blocked by persistent wake-up shell on public preview URL.

ui_bugs.issue: Homepage never mounts and remains on 'YuktiCart is still waking up...' across 1920/768/390.

integration_issues.issue: Runtime calls /undefined/api/health and gets 404, preventing full homepage sections from rendering.

action_items: Restore public preview runtime so homepage exits wake-up state and mounts full Home content.
Fix frontend runtime env wiring for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (currently producing /undefined/api/health).

After runtime fix, rerun targeted Playwright at 1920/768/390 to validate Blind Eye Deals heading, promotion image contain behavior, conditional bottom-right logo overlay, preserved destinations, and no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Home page keeps required section order in code: promotions -> categories -> stores -> influencer.
HomepagePromotions heading is exactly 'Blind Eye Deals'; no 'Featured promotions' label exists in this homepage component.
Promotion rendering uses desktop_image/mobile_image with picture/source support and object-contain image treatment.
Store logo derivation follows existing path: matching store by promotion.store_id, then store.logo_url fallback to getBrandAsset(store.name), and logo overlay is conditional.
Home reuses shared StoreSavingsCard import from Phase 2 and category links remain /category/:slug when slug exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run started from public URL testing with Playwright across desktop/tablet/mobile. All three viewports stuck at wake-up shell. Console repeatedly shows 404 at /undefined/api/health. Static code checks confirm requested Phase 4 presentation changes are implemented in referenced files, but runtime integration behavior (hero controls, links, logo overlay placement, no overflow) could not be asserted on mounted homepage.
rca of the issue: Repro: open https://cart-phase-audit.preview.emergentagent.com at 1920/768/390. App remains on wake-up screen and does not transition to homepage. Browser console logs 404 requests to /undefined/api/health, indicating missing/undefined REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at runtime. Mitigation: restore runtime env injection and warm preview; then rerun focused homepage Playwright validations.
